title: The Tower Next Door
logline: A kaya builds his tower right next to the stomper's giant one. Bad idea, because the stomper was still up there and he jumped.

segments.title: Only one of us will grow old

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: and hey, it's Bob! Taborgreat's just told the Stomper only one of them will grow old.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Charming. And the Stomper's answer to that is... dirt?

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Straight up, one block at a time, standing on it.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: That's towering, Bob. Stompers jump on people from up there.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Like my nan on the stairs.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Sixty-one blocks. That's not a tower, that's a lighthouse.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Earlier the Stomper asked taborgreat if he had a plan.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: He said he did, but it was on the ground.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: So now he's building his own tower, one block from the Stomper's.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Copying his homework. I did that at school.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: And you failed. Never build next to a Stomper.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Because he's still up there. Above you.
